listing.name: Ace Attorney Investigations Collection (nxnative-aa-port)
listing.summary: Build Ace Attorney Investigations Collection for Apple silicon Mac or iOS from your own version 1.0.0 Switch game. The project reports dialogue, menus, saving and loading. Court scenes and a full playthrough remain unconfirmed.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Prepare base game 1.0.0 for title 010005501E68C000 and your prod.keys. Use patched_v0 modules, extracted RomFS, shaders and the correct font and save paths for this title.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Use the game-specific GAME setting in the Mac dm/host/dmhost source build, or follow the iOS script to produce an IPA. There is no ready-made release.

warnings: Keep a copy of saves before rebuilding or updating. Compatibility across versions is unconfirmed.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The project reports 1080p display and working input. Exact hashes, region and other desktop systems are unconfirmed.
